content: Jack, what's wrong? You are not in a good mood.
My boss told me not to go to work again.
I made a huge mistake at work yesterday. I wouldn't have made that mistake if I had been more careful.
You are always careless. So what's your plan now?
I must find a new job as soon as possible.
But I think you should learn to be more careful before you find a new job, or you will make the same mistake again.
I guess you are right. So did you have a good time last night?
Yes, we played music and danced. But Susan didn't look very happy.
You wouldn't be happy either, if it were your thirtieth birthday.
Yes, you are right. No one wants to get old.
